mathematical_scope.average_precision: Non-interpolated AP = sum((recall_i-recall_(i+1))*precision_i) for archived decreasing-recall PR arrays, including their final sentinel. This is not trapezoidal PR-AUC.
mathematical_scope.quality_roc_auc: Trapezoidal area under ascending FPR/TPR, independently compared with pairwise concordance from integer tie-group counts recovered from the same curve and class supports.
mathematical_scope.objective_auc: The UPF cost/error AUC from the original audit is a different quantity. No objective AUC is substituted for quality.roc_auc.
mathematical_scope.exactness_basis: Frozen observations.binary_ranking calls exact score precision_recall_curve and roc_curve(drop_intermediate=False), marks exact_ties_grouped, and retains full coordinate arrays. Domain, endpoints, integer group counts and PR/ROC correspondence checked on the actual payloads.
mathematical_scope.candidate_scope: Curves refer to each candidate on its own batch holdout, with duplicate archival contexts in training_history and tracking_observations. They do not represent the pooled predictions of every deployed schedule.
mathematical_scope.policy_scope: Core.Metrics.values used by add_policy_quality returns pooled scalar metrics only; candidate curves lack common score thresholds and do not identify pooled cross-batch score ordering. Aggregated AP/AUROC cannot be reconstructed by averaging or concatenating normalized per-batch curves.
unrecoverable_metrics: pooled policy AP and AUROC without pooled curves or individual scores
limits: Consistency of retained ranking curves does not verify model inference, calibration, chronology or absence of leakage.
ROC area reconstructed from candidate curves has no stored same-scope scalar AUROC when that field is absent; it is not compared with the pooled schedule scalar.
No model, generator, training, inference or benchmark was executed. No service, API, tracking database or SQL was used.
The original 91742-check proof and all job sources remain unmodified.
